values.title: The contracting entity proposed a quick solution of cutting a channel without verifying the pavement base course
values.body: The other party is willing to add a linear drainage channel on the surface and provide a small compensation payment, but refuses to verify the drainage-channel connection and pavement base-course grading; accepting it could conceal the root cause of the ponding.

values.title: Exclusions from the surface joint-repair quote
values.body: The quote does not include drainage-channel reconnection, benchmark elevation resurveying, nursery-stock transplant restoration, or outdoor-light connection reinspection; these items must be timed and priced separately.
